title: Mario Woods debriefed and found with circular wounds at the base hospital
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Mario Woods debriefed and found with circular wounds at the base hospital, about 1960s at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's taken to the base hospital and examine he finds I think it was on his forehead and his ankle there was a circular uh wound or depression of some kind with a little dimple in the center

plain: Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFO reports at nuclear weapons bases, tells of a man named Mario Woods at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in the 1960s. Hastings says that after Woods was questioned about an incident, he was taken to the base hospital, where doctors found a circular wound or dent with a small dimple in the centre, he thinks on his forehead and his ankle. He tells it as a sign that something physical happened to Woods.
